scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.api.jsonc --secrets-file .api.secrets.example && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.sweeper.jsonc --secrets-file .sweeper.secrets.example

PAYMENT_API_KEY.description: Random server-to-server API key with at least 24 characters.

TURNKEY_ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Turnkey organization that owns the deposit wallet.

TURNKEY_WALLET_ID.description: Turnkey HD wallet used to allocate per-intent deposit addresses.

TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public half of the address-allocator-only Turnkey API credential.

TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private half of the address-allocator-only Turnkey API credential.

NETWORKS_JSON.description: JSON array of enabled EVM networks; see .dev.vars.example.

PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Absolute HTTPS URL that receives payment events.

PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random HMAC signing key with at least 24 characters.
